description: This file defines schema objects for various snapshot-related data structures using the TypeBox library, including presence entries, health snapshots, session defaults, state versions, and overall snapshot schemas.

methods.name: PresenceEntrySchema
methods.description: Schema defining the presence information with optional fields like host, ip, version, platform, device details, last input time, tags, text, timestamp, device id, roles, scopes, and instance id.

methods.name: HealthSnapshotSchema
methods.description: Schema placeholder for health snapshots, defined as any type.

methods.name: SessionDefaultsSchema
methods.description: Schema defining default session properties such as default agent id, main key, main session key, and optional scope.

methods.name: StateVersionSchema
methods.description: Schema representing state version with presence and health integers.

methods.name: SnapshotSchema
methods.description: Comprehensive schema representing the overall snapshot, including presence entries, health snapshot, state version, uptime, optional config path, state directory, optional session defaults, optional authentication mode, and optional update info.
